target.title: fix(elevenlabs): validate baseUrl with user-friendly error for malformed endpoints (fixes #106943)
target.body:
<details>
<summary>Additional instructions</summary>

**MUST:** Keep **Allow edits from maintainers** enabled for this PR so maintainers
can help update the branch when needed.

</details>

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where a malformed ElevenLabs `baseUrl` produces a raw `TypeError` from `new URL()` deep in the call chain. Additionally, the realtime transcription provider rejected direct `wss://` and `ws://` endpoints (self-hosted servers) because it routed through the shared HTTP(S)-only normalizer.

Concrete example on current `main`:
- `normalizeElevenLabsBaseUrl("not a url")` — propagates to `new URL("not a url")` deep in TTS/speech callers, producing an unhelpful `TypeError`
- Real-time provider config with `baseUrl: "wss://selfhosted.example.com"` — rejected by the shared normalizer before the realtime URL builder can convert it

## Why This Change Was Made

Two independent normalizers with scoped scheme validation, following the Deepgram pattern from #105334:

- `normalizeElevenLabsBaseUrl` (shared): validates `http`/`https` for REST/TTS/speech API callers. Strips query and fragment components so downstream path construction (`/v1/text-to-speech/...`) is not broken by trailing `?key=v` or `#anchor`.
- `normalizeElevenLabsRealtimeBaseUrl` (realtime): validates `http`/`https`/`ws`/`wss` for WebSocket transport. The realtime URL builder maps `http→ws` and `https→wss` while preserving direct `ws`/`wss` endpoints — matching exactly what the Deepgram provider does.

Non-goal: the shared normalizer intentionally rejects `ws`/`wss` — REST callers should never receive a WebSocket URL.

## User Impact

**Before:** Malformed `baseUrl` → raw `TypeError` with no actionable message. Self-hosted WebSocket endpoints (`wss://my-server.com`) → rejected at config validation. `baseUrl` with trailing query/fragment → silently broken downstream URL construction.

**After:** Malformed `baseUrl` → clear `Invalid ElevenLabs baseUrl: …` error. Self-hosted `ws://`/`wss://` endpoints accepted for realtime. Query/fragment components stripped safely. Valid URLs are unchanged.

## Evidence

- `extensions/elevenlabs/shared.ts` — shared normalizer: URL parse + scheme validation + query/fragment stripping
- `extensions/elevenlabs/realtime-transcription-provider.ts` — independent realtime normalizer accepting ws/wss, protocol mapping fix
- `extensions/elevenlabs/shared.test.ts` — 14 cases (6 new: query, fragment, both, path preservation, path+query)
- `extensions/elevenlabs/realtime-transcription-provider.test.ts` — 31 cases (13 new: ws/wss acceptance, errors, stripping, URL builder)
- `pnpm test extensions/elevenlabs/` — 59 passed, 0 regressions across 6 test files
- Function probe against the real production functions:

```
$ node --import tsx -e "import('./extensions/elevenlabs/shared.ts').then(m => { ... })"

=== normalizeElevenLabsBaseUrl (shared) ===
1. Valid https:           https://api.elevenlabs.io
2. Default (undefined):   https://api.elevenlabs.io
3. Query stripped:        https://api.elevenlabs.io       (input: https://api.elevenlabs.io?key=value)
4. Fragment stripped:     https://api.elevenlabs.io       (input: https://api.elevenlabs.io#section)
5. Path preserved:        https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1
6. Invalid URL:           Error: Invalid ElevenLabs baseUrl: value is not a valid URL
7. ws scheme rejected:    Error: Invalid ElevenLabs baseUrl: unsupported scheme "ws:" (expected http or https)

=== normalizeElevenLabsRealtimeBaseUrl ===
8.  Default (undefined):  https://api.elevenlabs.io
9.  Valid wss:            wss://selfhosted.example.com
10. Valid ws:             ws://localhost:8080
11. Query stripped:       wss://example.com               (input: wss://example.com?key=v)
12. Invalid URL:          Error: Invalid ElevenLabs realtime baseUrl: value is not a valid URL
13. Unsupported scheme:   Error: Invalid ElevenLabs realtime baseUrl: unsupported scheme "ftp:" (expected http, https, ws, or wss)

=== toElevenLabsRealtimeWsUrl ===
14. Default https → wss:  wss://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/speech-to-text/realtime?...
15. Self-hosted wss:      wss://selfhosted.example.com/v1/speech-to-text/realtime?...   (preserved)
16. Local ws:             ws://localhost:8080/v1/speech-to-text/realtime?...             (preserved)
```
